_readme: Site-wide announcement bar (top of every page). Set "active" to true to show it. "id" must change whenever the wording changes, so visitors who closed the old one see the new one. "ends" (YYYY-MM-DD, optional) hides it after that day, even before the next deploy. "link" is where the bar sends people (usually /booking).
text: Free trial week + free uniform when you enroll by Nov 20th.
